Game Overview

Capybara Screw Jam is a puzzle title where join a lovable capybara on a whimsical puzzle journey. Strategically place colorful dots to solve vibrant puzzles and unlock charming new characters. Delight in cheerful animations and ever-increasing challenges, making each victory a joyful celebration. Perfect your strategy with simple controls and immerse yourself in this enchanting adventure.
